scope: v2.31.1 patch review (300fe5a..HEAD, 26 files — refactor + 16 fixes)

framing.interpretation: Post-ship review of v2.31.1 patch — closes 16 prior findings + extracts 1098 LOC entry-files into 6 new core orchestrators

framing.scopeOut: state markdown files, bug specs, archive
assumptions: Risk concentrated in new modules + wiring
16 prior findings now fixed; verify no new regressions

findings.issue: Adversary verdict 'revise' bypassed when adjustedConfidence>=threshold. Line 369 was unconditional accept; ignored verdict.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unconditional second-accept branch. verdict='accept' required.

findings.issue: Doc lists deferralGate.*, selfAdversaryGate.*, researchRequiredGate.* but only longInputGate exists in flow-config-defaults.js.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit defaults in flow-config-defaults.js so config consumers can discover keys.

findings.issue: pickStopHookGate destructured without null-guard. Malformed return silently masked as longInputActive=false.
findings.recommendation: Validate return shape; default to null on malformed.

findings.issue: pickTopRemediation, selectAndRender, pickStopHookGate all replicate priority logic. Maintenance burden.
findings.recommendation: Extract shared _rankByPriority(gateIds) helper; both pickers call it.

findings.issue: Heredoc regex uses \n not \r?\n; CRLF line endings in fixtures could bypass.
Agent flagged the L-3 fix (explicit continue:false on max attempts) as a regression. Verified: this IS the intended L-3 behavior from prior review.
Agent claimed S-5 detectParentShell not implemented. Verified: function exists at line 43.
Agent flagged sequential await as perf bug. Sequential is correct semantic; parallelization would race the marker write.
Agent flagged fs.unlinkSync ENOENT-only catch as data integrity risk. Pre-existing behavior, not introduced by this patch.

verdict: concerns — 5 real findings + 4 adversary-rejected false positives. All 5 fixed in v2.31.2.
